name: WordPress
description: Open-source publishing platform used to build and manage websites — from blogs to enterprise sites — via block-based visual editing, themes, and an extensible plugin system.
best_for: Positioned by WordPress for creators, small businesses, enterprises, entrepreneurs, professional developers, and first-time bloggers who want a flexible, self-hosted publishing platform.
features: Extensive plugin library (stores, analytics, newsletters, social)
Official mobile apps for publishing on the go

alternatives.name: Wix
alternatives.description: A website builder for creating professional sites without coding, with hosting and business tools built in.
alternatives.best_for: Small business owners and individuals wanting an accessible, hosted way to build a site.

alternatives.name: Squarespace
alternatives.description: An all-in-one website builder combining design templates with ecommerce, scheduling, and marketing tools.
alternatives.best_for: Entrepreneurs and creatives who want a polished site plus built-in business tools.
